question: Who is the author of the novel, "Oliver Twist"?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Charles Dickens.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Charles Dickens** is the author of the novel **"Oliver Twist".**
 
• The novel was first published as a serial in a magazine called** "Bentley's Miscellany" in 1837-1839.**
 
• The story follows the life of an **orphan boy **named **Oliver Twist **who faces many challenges and hardships in Victorian London.
 
• The novel is known for its vivid portrayal of the social conditions and injustices of the time, particularly in relation to** poverty, crime, and the treatment of children.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• **Mark Twain **was an American author known for his works such as **"The Adventures of Tom Sawyer" and "Adventures of Huckleberry Finn".**
 
• **Oscar Wilde **was an Irish playwright and author known for his works such as **"The Picture of Dorian Gray" and "The Importance of Being Earnest".**
 
• **Jane Austen** was an English author known for her works such as** "Pride and Prejudice" and "Sense and Sensibility".**
